quotes.author: Ying
quotes.text: This was by far the best snorkeling experience we've ever had! We saw so many colorful fish and sea turtles. My three kids are strong swimmers, but I can't swim and have always been afraid of the water. Whether in Cancun, Big Island, or elsewhere, nonswimmers are usually ignored or left behind—even after paying. But Captain Bruce was completely different. He guided me one-on-one out to the deep-water coral reef and took me on a full tour. For the first time, I felt completely safe and not scared at all. The underwater world was absolutely breathtaking! A huge thank you to Captain Bruce and the crew for making this so special.

quotes.author: Cindy
quotes.text: Best family experience! Our group of 30 had an amazing time, and the crew went above and beyond to make everyone feel welcome. They were incredibly accommodating, friendly, and helpful, making the entire excursion seamless and unforgettable. Every single person in our group had a fantastic time, and we couldn't have asked for a better experience. Thank you for creating such wonderful memories for our family and friends—we'll be talking about this trip for years to come!

quotes.author: G
quotes.text: I had a wonderful experience with Captain Hosanna, Hannah and Jamie. Great crew and ensured everyone was safe and had a good time. It was a higher tide, so the sandbar was not visible. The "Hannah" Guarantee did not disappoint and several sea turtles were seen during the snorkeling portion of the tour. It was a great day and I totally encourage any and everyone to take the time and do the tour.

quotes.author: Diana
quotes.text: First time snorkeling with my daughter, the Captain’s team are always helpful and reliable. We have really fun time there, I even see a beautiful turtle swimming around me! We do appreciate the team’s great job, especially for Mr. Kaieb, he always appears nicely whenever we need help.

quotes.author: Sandy
quotes.text: Had such a great time! Casey was an awesome captain. The sandbar was beautiful and we had so much fun snorkeling. Musubi, snacks and drinks were served too, which was a nice touch. Wonderful experience, highly recommend!

quotes.author: Ka'ohinani
quotes.text: My friend and I really enjoyed our excursion to the sandbar in Kaneohe Bay. The crew was extremely professional and always kept safety as their top priority. We will definitely be back again. Mahalo for a good time!
